title: What goes in your profile, and what does each agent load?
context: The Claude.ai export is about 400 lines across 17 sections, and Claude Code memory holds 45 lessons about how you work. Loading all of it into every agent costs start-up context and puts private details in front of agents that are working on public repos. The orchestrator mainly needs your requirements: how you want work done and approved.

options.name: One file, everyone loads it all
options.summary: Merge everything into one profile; every agent reads it at start.

cons: Every agent pays for 400+ lines it mostly does not need
Private and confidential details reach agents on public repos, which can leak into commits or docs

options.name: Core plus project packs
options.summary: A short core every agent loads: how to talk to you, how approval and testing work, UI rules, git habits, and the boundaries between projects (stated as rules, without the confidential specifics). A pack per project, loaded only by agents in that project. Personal and contract details sit in a private section that agents read only when a task needs it. New lessons are dated and filed to the right place; changes to the core come to you as a batch.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='100' y='15' width='120' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='39' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Core (1-2 pages)</text><rect x='20' y='80' width='80' height='36' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='60' y='102' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>AcuLoad pack</text><rect x='120' y='80' width='80' height='36' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='102' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Ebb pack</text><rect x='220' y='80' width='80' height='36' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='260' y='102' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>F13LD pack</text><rect x='100' y='135' width='120' height='32' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><text x='160' y='155' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Private (on request)</text><text x='60' y='132' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>only there</text></svg>
pros: Small, fast start for every agent
Private details stay out of unrelated work
The orchestrator gets exactly your requirements
cons: An agent can miss something that was filed in the wrong pack

options.name: Core only; project knowledge moves to boards
options.summary: Keep just the core in the profile. Each project's knowledge becomes requirements and conventions on that project's board.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='100' y='15' width='120' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='39' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Core</text><rect x='20' y='100' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='60' y='122' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>AcuLoad</text><text x='60' y='136' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>board</text><rect x='120' y='100' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='122' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Ebb</text><text x='160' y='136' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>board</text><rect x='220' y='100' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='260' y='122' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>F13LD</text><text x='260' y='136' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>board</text><line x1='160' y1='57' x2='160' y2='98' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><polygon points='160,98 157.0,91.7 163.0,91.7' fill='currentColor'/></svg>
pros: One source of truth per project
cons: Only works where the hub runs; plain Claude Code or Claude.ai sessions lose the project context
A lot of seeding up front

recommendation: The orchestrator needs your requirements, not your biography. A short core plus the right project pack gives it that, and keeps confidential material away from agents that have no reason to see it.

settles.value: short core loaded by every agent; one pack per project loaded only in that project; private section read only when a task needs it; new lessons dated and filed, core changes approved in a batch
